column3: MT 30:1–2; the following verses of this psalm are MT +1. Close to the Hebrew; “the song of the dedication” is rendered “A Song at the dedication,” and דִלִּיתָנִי (“drawn me up”) “lifted me up.”
Close to the Hebrew; מִן־ שְׁאוֹל (“from Sheol”) is rendered “from the grave.”
Close to the Hebrew; חֲסִידָיו (“his godly ones”) is rendered “You saints of His,” and “his holy remembrance” “His holy name.”
Close to the Hebrew; אֲמִתֶּךָ (“your faithfulness”) is rendered “Your truth.”
Close to the Hebrew; מִסְפְּדִי (“my wailing”) is rendered “my mourning.”
Close to the Hebrew; כָבוֹד (“honor”) is rendered “my glory.”
